name: Schoolblazer Limited
summary: Schoolblazer Limited, an investment company, together with its subsidiaries, invests in small and medium-sized businesses. The company invests in diversified asset categories, including listed, unlisted equities, fixed income, and funds management activities. It also provides support to investees, including directorship capabilities and facilitation of management services. The company was formerly known as Hancock & Gore Ltd and changed its name to Schoolblazer Limited in February 2026. Schoolblazer Limited was founded in 1867 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
